caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate jug or pitcher and an enlarged detail of its lid, labeled "COVER." The jug is predominantly brown with hints of red and gold, and is decorated with raised floral patterns, featuring flowers and leaves in a lighter, yellowish-brown hue. The body of the jug is rounded and bulges outward before narrowing at the neck, then flaring out again slightly at the rim. The handle is wide and curves smoothly from the top to the middle of the body. The lid of the jug is topped with a sculpted small animal, possibly a squirrel, sitting upright. The upper section of the jug, near the neck and handle, features a band of detailed animal motifs, which appear to be running or standing quadrupeds. The enlarged depiction of the lid shows it is circular, has a central raised floral motif, and is bordered by a ring of small round elements. The overall color palette consists primarily of browns and yellows, with shading to indicate the three-dimensional form of the jug. The drawing is on a beige background, and a fine rectangular border encloses the scene.
title: Teapot
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
